LBR.note: Consumer awareness on standards is not a rule or complaints body for digital financial services.

facts.fact: ISO's member page lists the Liberia Standards Authority (LiSA) as a Correspondent member of ISO.

LBR.note: Nothing on consultation on a named digital law or policy.

facts.fact: ISO's member page says the Liberia Standards Authority was established by law in 2022 and operationalised in 2024 as the national body for developing and maintaining Liberian standards.
